entries.partTitle: Serverless Event Topology: Amazon EventBridge Bus, Filtering & Rule Routing

left.title: Synchronous Coupling
items: Direct HTTP calls cause cascading timeouts.
Connection exhaustion under heavy traffic.
Producers tightly coupled to consumer endpoints.

right.title: EventBridge Bus
items: Asynchronous serverless event bus ingestion.
Content-based declarative filter rules.
Eliminates unnecessary downstream invocations.

steps.annotation: Direct synchronous HTTP calls risk cascading service timeouts.
EventBridge decouples publishers from consumers via event buses.
Router directs standard and vip orders to appropriate queues.
Declarative filter rules eliminate unnecessary compute invocations.

entries.partTitle: High-Fanout Broadcasts: Amazon SNS Topic Subscriptions & Filter Policies

left.title: Point-to-Point Notify
items: Sequential notification calls inflate latency.
Adding new consumers requires code changes.
Single subscriber failure impacts all endpoints.

right.title: SNS Fan-Out Hub
items: Broadcasts events to thousands of queues in parallel.
Subscription filter policies route relevant data.
Raw message delivery strips envelope overhead.

steps.annotation: Sequential consumer notifications introduce high transaction latency.
SNS topic fans out broadcast messages to multiple endpoints.
Topic applies attribute filter policies to route dispatch events.
Subscription filters ensure subscribers receive only relevant data.

entries.partTitle: Ordered Processing: Amazon SQS FIFO Queues, Message Groups & Deduplication

left.title: Standard Queues
items: At-least-once delivery can introduce duplicates.
Messages may arrive out of chronological order.
State machines risk data corruption on retries.

right.title: SQS FIFO Queues
items: Guarantees exact First-In First-Out delivery.
MessageGroupId preserves order per account.
Automatic deduplication discards network retries.

steps.annotation: Standard queues risk out of order delivery and duplicate messages.
FIFO queues guarantee strict chronological message delivery order.
Queue executes sequential transactions with message deduplication.
Message groups enable parallel processing across independent accounts.

entries.partTitle: Fault Isolation: SQS Dead Letter Queues, Redrive Mechanics & Poison-Pill Defense

left.title: Unmanaged Retries
items: Malformed messages crash workers repeatedly.
Infinite retry loops exhaust compute resources.
Healthy messages trapped behind failing payloads.

right.title: Dead Letter Queue
items: Evicts failing messages after max receive threshold.
Isolates poison pills to protect queue throughput.
Automated redrive tasks reprocess patched items.

steps.annotation: Malformed poison pill payloads cause repeated consumer worker crashes.
Dead letter queues isolate unprocessable messages after retry limits.
Queue isolates poison payload while allowing healthy items to proceed.
Automated redrive tasks return quarantined messages once resolved.

entries.partTitle: Enterprise Synthesis: End-to-End Serverless Event Pipeline & Verification

left.title: Monolithic Pipeline
items: Direct component coupling magnifies downtime.
Traffic spikes overwhelm downstream databases.
Lacks end-to-end tracing and verification token.

right.title: Choreographed Event Tier
items: EventBridge, SNS, SQS FIFO, and DLQs synthesized.
Backpressure buffering absorbs sudden order spikes.
Emits cryptographic confirmation token upon test.

steps.annotation: Direct component coupling causes cascading failures under heavy load.
Choreographed event architecture decouples producers from consumers.
Pipeline synthesizes routing fanout buffering and fault isolation.
Synthesis confirms end to end pipeline operational and emits token.
